Integrar os testes automatizados ao pipeline de CI/CD, garantindo que nenhum código quebre as funcionalidades existentes (testes de regressão).  Execução e Análise Realizar testes exploratórios em novas funcionalidades para identificar cenários complexos que a automação pode não cobrir.  Analisar logs e ferramentas de monitoramento para investigar a causa raiz de incidentes reportados.  Colaboração Técnica Auxiliar os desenvolvedores na escrita de testes de integração e sugerir melhorias na arquitetura voltadas para a testabilidade.  Gerir a massa de dados necessária para a execução dos testes em diferentes ambientes.    Quais são os requisitos obrigatórios para esse cargo?    Cypress para testes E2E e de componentes (front-end)  JavaScript/TypeScript para escrita e manutenção de scripts de teste  Automação de testes de API REST (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, PATCH)  Validação de contratos de API (schema validation, JSON Schema)  Testes de integração entre serviços  Page Object Model (POM) e padrões de design para automação  Gerenciamento de fixtures, hooks e plugins no Cypress API & Back-end  Ferramentas: Postman, Insomnia ( Supertest )  Autenticação: OAuth2, JWT, API Key, Basic Auth  Interpretação e validação de payloads (JSON/XML)  Testes de contrato Banco de Dados: SQL - queries, joins, validação de dados pós-transação (PostgreSQL, MySQL) - e NoSQL - MongoDB, Redis (leitura e validação de dados).  Validação de consistência de dados entre API e banco Observabilidade & Logs  Leitura e análise de logs de aplicação (Kibana, Splunk, Datadog, Grafana)  Correlação de logs com falhas de teste  Monitoramento de erros em tempo real Métricas & Qualidade  Definição e acompanhamento de métricas: cobertura de testes, taxa de falha, flakiness, tempo de execução  Dashboards de qualidade ( Azure DevOps)  Análise de tendências e regressões CI/CD & DevOps  Integração de testes em pipelines: GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, Azure DevOps  Versionamento com Git (branches, PRs, conventional commits)    Quais serão os requisitos diferencias para este cargo?    BDD com Gherkin/Cucumber (escrita de cenários Given/When/Then)  Planejamento e estimativa de esforço de testes  Revisão de requisitos e identificação de critérios de aceite  Gestão de bugs: ciclo de vida, priorização, evidências (Jira, Azure DevOps)  Testes exploratórios e análise de risco  Shift-left testing: envolvimento desde o refinamento  Experiência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban)    Aqui você vai encontrar:    Vale Refeição/Vale Alimentação (Cartão Flash benefícios), Plano de Saúde, Plano Odontológico, Seguro de Vida, PPR, TotalPass, Auxílio Creche, Programa Well-Being (destinado para saúde física e mental), Universidade Corporativa (nossa #SensediaAcademy), com diversas trilhas de desenvolvimento; Parceiros culturais e educacionais, com descontos especiais; Somos uma empresa cidadã, proporcionando licença maternidade e licença paternidade estendida.     Temos #WorkWhereYouBelong como proposta de valor, que é um modelo flexível de trabalho que nos ajuda a aumentar o senso de pertencimento dos Sensediers.Trabalhe onde você pertence, porque as barreiras físicas estão menores, e o sentimento é de que exista apenas uma Sensedia em qualquer lugar que você esteja trabalhando.    Esta oportunidade também é para PCD! ;)   Suas experiências são compatíveis? Se candidate e venha conhecer a maior referência de APIs no Brasil! Queremos você em nossa equipe!! title: Senior IT Engineer – Global Offices Network
description:

About Us  Nu is one of the largest digital financial platforms in the world, with more than 127 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. Guided by our mission to fight complexity and empower people, we are redefining financial services in Latin America — and this is still just the beginning of the purple future we’re building.  Listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: NU), we combine proprietary technology, data intelligence, and an efficient operating model to deliver financial products that are simple, accessible, and human. Our impact has been recognized by global rankings such as Time 100 Companies, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and Forbes World’s Best Bank.Learn more about our career opportunities here.  About the Role  We are looking for a Senior IT Engineer  to design, implement, and operate our global office and data center network . In this role, you will own the connectivity and performance of Nu’s physical locations, ensuring that our offices and data centers are reliable, secure, and ready to support our next waves of growth.  You will work on routing, switching, wireless, security, and observability  across our global stack, leading key initiatives such as new office rollouts, critical connectivity improvements, and the evolution towards Infrastructure as Code (IaC) . You will be part of the Global Offices Network  team, working closely with peers in Connectivity, Security, and Workplace to provide a seamless experience for Nubankers worldwide.  What You’ll Be Responsible For  Network & Connectivity    Design, implement, and support enterprise network infrastructure  for offices and data centers, including routing, switching, and wireless.  Maintain and evolve high‑availability data center fabrics  (e.g., spine‑and‑leaf topologies with Juniper/Cisco hardware).  Ensure robust connectivity between offices and data centers , including WAN and SD‑WAN solutions, focusing on performance, reliability, and scalability.  Configure and support wireless networks  (controllers and access points), with strong experience in vendors such as Aruba  and Cisco.  Operate and tune load balancers  (e.g., F5 , including DNS/ZoneRunner concepts) to guarantee optimal application delivery and resilience.  Collaborate with security teams on Next‑Generation Firewalls  (e.g., Palo Alto, Fortinet) and cloud security brokers  (e.g., Zscaler) in a “security‑first” network design.    Automation, IaC & Observability    Drive the transition away from manual configuration towards Infrastructure as Code (IaC)  using tools such as GitHub, Terraform, and/or Ansible .  Implement and maintain network performance monitoring  and observability using tools like PRTG, Prometheus, Grafana, SolarWinds or similar , ensuring proactive detection and resolution of incidents.  Manage PKI-related activities , including SSL/TLS certificate lifecycle and ensuring secure encrypted communications across services and endpoints.    Delivery & Collaboration    Lead or co‑lead new office implementations  and major network changes, coordinating with Workplace, Connectivity, and other partner teams.  Act as a technical reference for incident response and problem management  in critical networking issues, helping restore services quickly and preventing recurrences.  Document architectures, runbooks, and standards, helping scale knowledge across the team.  Mentor more junior engineers and collaborate in a multi‑level team  (IC6, IC5, IC3, IC4) to continuously improve how we operate our global infrastructure.    We Are Looking for a Person Who Has   5+ years of experience  in enterprise networking or infrastructure engineering , working with critical environments (e.g., large offices, data centers, or mission‑critical operations).  Strong hands‑on experience with routing and switching , ideally using vendors such as Cisco  and/or Juniper.  Experience implementing and supporting wireless networks , especially with Aruba  and/or Cisco wireless solutions.  Solid experience operating network monitoring and performance tools  (e.g., PRTG, SolarWinds, Prometheus, Grafana  or similar) in production environments. You will play a vital role in evolving the architecture of one of our most complex and strategic products.  You will operate within a high‑impact triad alongside Product and Management, focusing on long‑term technical strategy and system health. As a hands‑on technical leader, you will challenge the status quo, propose innovation and solve deep architectural problems, mentor and become a technical reference for our engineering team. Your work will directly enable millions of customers to access financial products via credit card worldwide.  Responsibilities   Define and drive the long‑term vision and strategy for the global architecture of the core credit card platform, ensuring exponential scalability and continuous evolution capability.  Lead the strategic partnership with Product and Business leadership (C‑level and VPs) to shape the medium and long‑term technical roadmap and define the strategic OKRs and global impact KPIs.  Act as a technical and cultural reference, defining the highest standards of engineering excellence, mentoring other Architects and Principal/Staff Engineers, and fostering a culture of innovation and accountability.  Lead and resolve the most ambitious and high‑risk technical challenges, intervening in critical performance or resilience bottlenecks and driving technical execution for solutions with multi‑system and multi‑country impact. Communicate and defend the technical strategy eloquently and convincingly to the executive board and non‑technical audiences, translating architecture decisions into business value and competitive advantage. Expert proficiency (demonstrated in code and design) in multiple programming paradigms, with significant hands‑on experience in functional programming (e.g., Clojure, Scala, Haskell) and reactive/event‑based architectures.  Proven ability to establish and lead the long‑term technical strategy for entire platform ecosystems (not just isolated components), influencing the direction of multiple engineering groups.  Deep and successful experience in navigating and defining the architecture in highly regulated financial environments (e.g., BACEN, FCA, SOX) and designing systems to meet data residency requirements and complex cross‑border transactions.  History of successfully leading and completing large‑scale platform transformations (e.g., transition from monoliths to microservices mesh, migration of data centers or clouds), managing risks and operational impact.  In‑depth knowledge of credit card/payment systems design is a significant differential.    Nice to Have   Experience with Clojure or similar functional languages.  Proven interest or experience in leveraging AI to optimize engineering workflows.  Deep domain knowledge of credit card processing or financial ledgers.    Location & Work Model  This role is based on a hybrid model at one of our Nubank offices in Brazil (São Paulo, Campinas, Rio de Janeiro, or Belo Horizonte), the United States (Palo Alto, Durham, Washington D.C. or Miami), or Canada (Toronto) . Experience in B2B, marketplace, e‑commerce, or large‑scale platforms.    What We Value:   A curious mindset and investigative approach to deeply understand problems before solving them. Interest in growing within a team that values excellence, autonomy, and continuous learning. title: Commercial Strategy Specialist
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Commercial Strategy Specialist em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world’s top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands,we’renumber one or two in many of the world’s top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.  About ABI GrowthGroup  ABI’s Growth Division is the center of innovation and tech development within ABI, whichis drivingABI’s growth by developing innovations for the core beer business and creating new hyper‑growth tech businesses. ABI Growth includes the following business lines: BEES (our business‑to‑business e‑commerce and SaaS business, also focused on new technologies), TaDaand Ze Delivery (our direct‑to‑consumer e‑commerce businesses), and several other high‑tech divisions, including fintech and venture capital.  This role will be largely dedicated to BEES, which is on a mission to transform ABI’s business‑to‑business sales model by putting customers and data at its heart. Whether you are a small to medium sized retailer or a supplying partner, BEES provides you with the tools, data, and insights you need to help your business thrive. Today, more than 2.5 million retailers across 19 countries use BEES every month to browse for products, place orders, earn rewards, arrange deliveries, manage invoices, and access business insights all from one place.  Learn more on how BEES keeps business buzzing at   About the Role  The Commercial Strategy Specialist is responsible for maximizing profitable growth across BEES Link 3P through strong governance, analytical rigor, and scalable operating standards. Aligned with our mission — to maximize profitable growth by institutionalizing pricing compliance, P&L governance, disciplined product prioritization, and scalable operating processes — this role plays a critical part in strengthening the structural foundations of our commercial model.  This position sits at the intersection of Commercial, Product, Finance, and Operations. The Commercial Strategy Specialist transforms complex business problems into data‑driven insights and scalable frameworks that protect margins, improve investment allocation, and accelerate disciplined decision‑making. This is a high‑impact role designed for a senior professional who combines strategic thinking with hands‑on analytical execution.  What You'll Do   Own P&L governance for BEES Link 3P, consolidating partner‑level performance data and translating it into clear visibility on margin health, revenue quality, and profitability trends.  Provide broad‑ranging legal advice to other teams across ABI Growth, including relating to SaaS and licensing transactions, strategic commercial relationships, data monetization strategies, data privacy projects, and product counseling.  Build and maintain scalable operating frameworks — standard templates, decision criteria, governance protocols — that reduce dependence on ad‑hoc judgment and improve process consistency.  Drive product prioritization rigor by developing structured intake processes, effort‑impact scoring models, and backlog governance routines that align roadmap decisions with commercial outcomes.  Design and maintain investment evaluation frameworks that assess initiatives against a shared value logic, distinguishing between cost avoidance, governance improvement, and incremental revenue generation.  Develop and update reference models for take rate and GMV impact analysis, enabling leadership to make pricing and product decisions grounded in real partner data.  Identify operational bottlenecks and inefficiencies across the OTC and GTM cycle, and lead initiatives to eliminate waste and improve execution speed without compromising governance standards.  Synthesize cross‑functional inputs — from Commercial, Finance, Product, and Operations — into integrated business reviews that surface risks early and enable proactive course correction.  Support JBP structuring and partner onboarding processes by providing analytical and governance scaffolding that ensures new engagements are commercially sound from the outset.    What You'll Need   Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field; advanced degree (MBA, MSc) is a strong differentiator.  Experience in a business analytics, commercial operations, strategy, or financial governance role, ideally within a technology, marketplace, or CPG environment.  Proven ability to build and operationalize governance frameworks, pricing models, or P&L management tools in complex, multi‑stakeholder environments.  Strong analytical proficiency — advanced Excel/Google Sheets, SQL, or Python/R — with the ability to work directly with large datasets and translate findings into executive‑level insights.  Demonstrated experience with take‑rate modeling, GMV analysis, or margin management in a platform or marketplace business is a significant plus.  Desire to help build the legal function and data privacy program from the ground up.  Effective communicator who can synthesize complex analytical work into clear business narratives for senior leadership and cross‑functional partners.  Practical legal approach, focused on enabling the business strategy rather than a compliance‑first mindset.  Fully fluent in English and Portuguese; proficiency in Spanish is a plus.    What We Offer   Performance based bonus*  Attendance Bonus*  Casual office and dress code  Days off*Health, dental, and life insurance  Discounts on Ambev products*  School materials assurance  Language and training platforms    Equal Opportunity & Affimative Action  AB InBev Growth Group is proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affimative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon of race, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.   #J-18808-Ljbffr

Preferimos pedir desculpas ao invés de pedir permissão e estamos sempre dispostos a nos transformar, nos reinventar.Nossas pessoas são incríveis e você pode fazer parte disso tudo. Nos comprometemos em garantir um ambiente de trabalho acolhedor e respeitoso.  Conheça + em nosso site:   Qual a missão do Cargo? Participar de discussões de arquitetura e decisões técnicas (event-driven, hexagonal, domain-driven).  Implementar e manter padrões de segurança (OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect, mTLS, JWT).  Realizar code reviews e zelar por padrões de código, testes e documentação (OpenAPI/Swagger).  Monitorar e otimizar performance (profiling, tuning de queries, caching, concorrência).  Instrumentar observabilidade (logs estruturados, métricas, tracing distribuído) e responder a incidentes.  Colaborar com Produto, QA, SRE/Cloud e Suporte; antecipar riscos e propor mitigação.  Atuar como referência técnica, apoiando desenvolvedores menos experientes e disseminando boas práticas.    Quais são os requisitos obrigatórios para esse cargo?    Experiência sólida em backend com Java (preferencialmente 17+), POO e princípios SOLID.  Spring Boot e arquitetura hexagonal; conhecimento de event-driven (ex.: SNS/SQS, eventos de domínio).  APIs RESTful e documentação OpenAPI (Swagger).  Maven (ou Gradle) para build e gestão de dependências.  AWS: uso prático de SNS, SQS, RDS, S3, CloudWatch, ECR e DocumentDB/MongoDB.  Docker/docker-compose e noções de Kubernetes (manifests básicos, deployments, services, troubleshooting com kubectl).  Observabilidade: logs, métricas e tracing (conceitos).  Bancos relacionais e não relacionais; modelagem e domínio de queries.  CI/CD e metodologias ágeis (branching, pipelines, PRs, feature flags).  Segurança de aplicações: OWASP (ASVS/Top 10), JWT/JWS, mTLS, boas práticas de secrets.  Vivência em ambientes críticos e de alta disponibilidade.  Identidade & Segurança: experiência com Identity & Access Management (Keycloak ou equivalente) e implementação de OAuth 2.0/OpenID Connect em produção.    Quais serão os requisitos diferencias para este cargo?    Profundidade em Keycloak (realms, clients, policies, mappers) e OAuth 2.0 (grants, PAR, JAR, DCR).  Observabilidade avançada: Prometheus, Grafana e OpenTelemetry (traces e métricas end-to-end).  Performance & escalabilidade: baixa latência/alta concorrência (profilers, k6/JMeter, tuning de JVM).  Helm e Infra as Code (Terraform) para padronização de deploys.  JavaScript/TypeScript para manutenção de mocks de testes/interceptors.  Participação em comunidades técnicas, eventos ou projetos open source.  Liderança técnica (guildas, chapters, definição de padrões, mentoria). About Us  Nubank was founded in 2013 to free people from a bureaucratic, slow and inefficient financial system. Since then, through innovative technology and outstanding customer service, the company has been redefining people's relationships with money across Latin America. With operations in Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia, Nubank is today one of the largest digital banking platforms and technology-leading companies in the world. Nubank was listed on the NYSE in 2021 and was recently named one of Time Magazine's 100 Most Influential Companies. For more information, visit About the Role  At Nubank, our Credit Card platform is the core of our global expansion. We are looking for a Staff Engineer to join our platform team as a technical anchor, ensuring our systems remain scalable and flexible as we maintain sustainable growth and innovation in the countries where we currently operate, while also launching into new international markets. You will play a vital role in evolving the architecture of one of our most complex and strategic products. You will operate within a high-impact triad alongside Product and Management, focusing on long-term technical strategy and system health. As a hands-on technical leader, you will challenge the status quo, propose innovation and solve deep architectural problems, mentor and become a technical reference for our engineering team. Your work will directly enable millions of customers to access financial products via credit card worldwide. Responsibilities  Define and drive the long-term vision and strategy for the global architecture of the core credit card platform, ensuring exponential scalability and continuous evolution capability. Lead the strategic partnership with Product and Business leadership (C-level and VPs) to shape the medium and long-term technical roadmap and define the strategic OKRs and global impact KPIs. Act as a technical and cultural reference, defining the highest standards of engineering excellence, mentoring other Architects and Principal/Staff Engineers, and fostering a culture of innovation and accountability. Lead and resolve the most ambitious and high-risk technical challenges, intervening in critical performance or resilience bottlenecks and driving technical execution for solutions with multi-system and multi-country impact. Design and oversee the execution of complex system transformations (e.g., core banking migrations, replacement of legacy platforms) ensuring regulatory compliance in multiple jurisdictions and fiscal regimes, proactively mitigating risks. Communicate and defend the technical strategy eloquently and convincingly to the executive board and non-technical audiences, translating architecture decisions into business value and competitive advantage.  Required Qualifications  Principal/Staff Engineer level experience or equivalent with an extensive and demonstrable history in architecting and scaling mission-critical, high-volume, and low-latency systems in global fintech or e-commerce environments. Expert proficiency (demonstrated in code and design) in multiple programming paradigms, with significant hands-on experience in functional programming (e.g., Clojure, Scala, Haskell) and reactive/event-based architectures. Proven ability to establish and lead the long-term technical strategy for entire platform ecosystems (not just isolated components), influencing the direction of multiple engineering groups. Deep and successful experience in navigating and defining the architecture in highly regulated financial environments (e.g., BACEN, FCA, SOX) and designing systems to meet data residency requirements and complex cross-border transactions. History of successfully leading and completing large-scale platform transformations (e.g., transition from monoliths to microservices mesh, migration of data centers or clouds), managing risks and operational impact. In-depth knowledge of credit card/payment systems design is a significant differential.  Nice to Have  Experience with Clojure or similar functional languages. Proven interest or experience in leveraging AI to optimize engineering workflows. Deep domain knowledge of credit card processing or financial ledgers.  Location & Work Model  This role is based on a hybrid model at one of our Nubank offices in Brazil (São Paulo, Campinas, Rio de Janeiro, or Belo Horizonte), the United States (Palo Alto, Durham, Washington D.C. or Miami), or Canada (Toronto) . title: Gerente Jr de Qualidade (Time Comercial)
description:
Empresa está contratando Gerente Jr de Qualidade (Time Comercial) em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

Gerente Jr de Qualidade (Time Comercial) Job Locations: BR-Campinas ID:   Company Overview Se para você a tecnologia existe para melhorar o caminho da vida, para o nosso time também: Seu Caminho, Nossa Jornada. Acreditamos na tecnologia que conecta gente boa no que faz e que vive a diversidade para criar e compartilhar até os caminhos que a gente (ainda!) nem sabe quais são. Trabalhamos para gerar valor não só para os nossos usuários, mas, sobretudo, para as comunidades que servimos e toda a sociedade, tornando a vida das pessoas melhor com serviços que facilitem seu dia a dia - seja com serviços de mobilidade e entrega (99) ou pagamentos digitais (99Pay). Para facilitar a vida de milhões de pessoas todos os dias, desde 2018 fazemos parte da DiDi Global Inc., a maior plataforma de tecnologia e transporte por aplicativo do mundo. Somos pioneiros na criação de soluções inovadoras que começam no Brasil e que ganham escala para gerar impacto positivo em mais de 12 países em que a DiDi está presente. Essas inovações passam por sustentabilidade, segurança, inteligência artificial, mercado financeiro e um tanto mais. Seja para construir projetos do zero ou aprimorar nossas soluções, gostamos de desafios que nos fazem sentir frio na barriga, e é por isso que trabalhamos num ritmo acelerado, com respeito, colaboração e bom humor. Nessa jornada, também nos fortalecemos nas diferentes vivências e opiniões para crescermos juntos, errar rápido, aprender e ajustar o caminho para criar soluções que tragam ainda melhores resultados. #LI-Hybrid  Team Overview Você fará parte do recém-criado time de Qualidade Comercial, como colaborador individual, dentro da nossa estrutura de Enablement Comercial na 99Food, uma operação comprometida em escalar vendas de campo de alta performance com as habilidades, consistência e impacto adequados. Sua missão é atuar como o “guardião da qualidade”, monitorando tudo o que pode dar errado na operação de vendas — desde a execução de habilidades até o uso de sistemas e a aderência a processos — garantindo diagnóstico e correção rápidos. Este papel combina observação em campo, auditoria orientada por dados e feedback estratégico, impulsionando ações imediatas e melhorias de longo prazo no nosso motor de vendas.  Role Responsibilities Projetar, implementar e liderar um framework abrangente de Qualidade de Vendas, incluindo auditorias aprofundadas, scorecards (técnicos, comportamentais, de processo e de uso de sistemas) e mecanismos estruturados de feedback. Conduzir auditorias ao longo de toda a jornada comercial, observando visitas em campo, registros em CRM/sistemas, demonstrações, e-mails e aderência a playbooks, para identificar desvios e oportunidades. Gerenciar, junto ao time, visitas frequentes em campo ao lado de Business Developers para observar a execução em tempo real, avaliar necessidades de coaching e validar o comportamento real versus o documentado. Analisar padrões de uso em CRMs e outras ferramentas comerciais para detectar lacunas, subutilização ou uso indevido, retroalimentando insights para treinamentos, base de conhecimento (KB) e melhorias de processo. Atuar como guardião da excelência: monitorar a conformidade com playbooks, fluxos de processo, base de conhecimento e uso de ferramentas, garantindo alinhamento em cada interação dos BDs. Colaborar com os times de Sales Enablement, Produto, Operações e Tecnologia para traduzir achados de QA em melhorias, aprimorando a base de conhecimento, módulos de treinamento, fluxos de trabalho e sistemas. Produzir relatórios recorrentes com insights de QA, lacunas emergentes, tendências e recomendações priorizadas para ações corretivas rápidas e evolução estratégica. Orientar e desenvolver Especialistas de QA, promovendo uma cultura de melhoria contínua, consistência e execução de qualidade baseada em dados. Defender melhorias operacionais, de processo e sistêmicas com uma mentalidade orientada por hipóteses e forte alinhamento com princípios mais amplos de Controle de Qualidade.   Role Qualifications Mínimo de 5 a 7 anos de experiência em gestão da qualidade, auditoria de processos ou QA de vendas, especialmente em vendas de campo, tecnologia ou ambientes em escala. Capacidade comprovada de desenhar frameworks robustos de QA, incluindo scorecards, matrizes de performance, rotinas de auditoria e fluxos de escalonamento. Alta capacidade analítica: transformar dados quantitativos (CRM, métricas, dashboards) e observações qualitativas (campo, demos) em insights acionáveis. Experiência com plataformas de CRM, monitoramento de uso de sistemas e compreensão de como sistemas impactam o comportamento comercial. Perfil “mão na massa” e presença em campo: conforto para realizar visitas, avaliações presenciais e trabalhar próximo aos times operacionais. Fortes habilidades de comunicação, com assertividade para apontar lacunas operacionais e colaborar entre áreas para resolvê-las. Mentalidade de melhoria contínua, com resultados comprovados na transformação de insights de qualidade em ações práticas (treinamentos, atualizações de KB, refinamentos de processos/sistemas). Certificações como Six Sigma/Black Belt ou experiência em Enablement são diferenciais.   EEO Statement Geramos Valor para os Usuários - Existimos para fazer o melhor para os nossos usuários e inovamos para estarmos sempre na frente. Buscamos o equilíbrio entre experiência, eficiência e crescimento, tendo a segurança sempre em primeiro lugar. Somos Guiados por Dados - Acreditamos na tomada de decisão guiada por dados. Através dos números, navegamos em nosso negócio de forma estratégica. Somos Donos e Focados nos Resultados - Vamos além dos interesses pessoais para focar no que é melhor para a DiDi. Sempre cumprimos o que prometemos e buscamos a excelência na execução, estabelecendo uma barra alta e dando o nosso máximo em tudo que fazemos. Sempre Construímos Juntos - Juntos somos mais fortes. Temos a mente aberta e sempre remamos com respeito, empatia e confiança uns nos outros. Ouvimos a opinião de todos antes de tomar uma decisão e, quando decidimos algo, cumprimos o combinado juntos, mesmo se discordarmos. Somos Íntegros - Integridade é a nossa base e a linha que nunca ultrapassamos. Comunicamos com honestidade, transparência e ouvimos a voz de todos para sempre fazer o que é certo. Desenvolvemos uns aos Outros - Nosso crescimento vem da constante aventura de estarmos fora da nossa zona de conforto. Aceitamos desafios, nos superamos e trabalhamos em busca da excelência em tudo que fazemos. Desde o primeiro dia, nos desenvolvemos e ajudamos as pessoas ao nosso redor a crescerem também, elevando a nossa barra. Trabalhamos com Paixão & Diversão - Somos completamente apaixonados pelo que fazemos. Mantemos um espírito leve e otimista, contagiando o nosso ambiente com energia positiva. Somos resilientes, não temos medo de enfrentar desafios e sempre celebramos nosso sucesso. Vivemos a Diversidade - Para nós, o coração da diversidade é a inclusão, a igualdade e o respeito. Acreditamos que a diversidade promove um ambiente mais criativo e cheio de energia, por isso, celebramos as diferenças e aqui todos podem ser quem são.  Diversidade e Inclusão  Diversidade não é uma visão de futuro ou desejo de algo que queremos um dia, é um valor inegociável de quem somos hoje. Vivemos a inclusão, a pluralidade e o respeito e, para isso, contamos com a governança do Comitê de Diversidade que atua junto com o RH, a nossa liderança e os grupos de identidade - 99Adapta, 99Afro, 99Cores, 99Mulheres e 99Famílias. Essa é a nossa jornada já escrita que ainda tem muito caminho para percorrer. Company Overview  BotCity is building the future of automation with the Governance Platform for Python automations and AI Agents. We empower enterprises to innovate at scale, bringing governance, control, and observability to every automation project. Our philosophy is simple: automation is software, and software deserves the same high-code standards that drive innovation in AI and machine learning.  We recently raised a $12M Series A, led by Four Rivers with participation from Y Combinator, SoftBank, and top industry leaders such as Lew Cirne (New Relic), Rod Johnson (Spring Source), and Walter Kortschak (Summit Partners | Firestreak Ventures). With 1,000+ customers in 70+ countries, including Bayer and LG, and recognition by G2 (2024) as one of the world’s top 25 emerging platforms, BotCity is scaling fast.  We’re a global remote company with teams across the US and LATAM, united by a shared vision to redefine how enterprises build and manage automation. If you’re looking for an environment that values impact, autonomy, and excellence, we’d love for you to join us on this journey.  Role Overview  The Sales Engineer will be responsible for increasing win rate and accelerating deal progression by leading structured technical validation across the sales cycle, ensuring strong credibility with IT, Automation, and Information Security stakeholders. This professional will play a key role in reducing technical friction, strengthening customer confidence in BotCity’s governance platform, and standardizing how architecture, security, and integration topics are addressed during pre‑sales. We are seeking a technically strong professional with experience in enterprise architecture and deployment, and security fundamentals, capable of engaging in deep architectural discussions, handling risk‑based objections, and contributing to internal technical enablement through training and materials development. The ideal candidate combines structured thinking, clear communication, and commercial awareness, working collaboratively with Sales, Product, and Engineering in a fast‑paced environment. This role will report to the Head of Sales.  Responsibilities   Join discovery and technical deep‑dive calls to lead architecture and governance discussions with the customers’ technical stakeholders.  Validate integration feasibility, deployment models, and security positioning before advancing deals.  Support security and compliance conversations, including participation in customer security reviews and questionnaires.  Identify technical risks early in the sales cycle and prevent overcommitment or scope misalignment.  Assist with technical sections of proposals, RFPs, and enterprise documentation requests.  Build and continuously update customer‑facing enablement materials such as, but not limited to, architecture diagrams and data flow documentation.  Develop and maintain a structured technical objection library aligned with governance and cybersecurity concerns.  Standardize the technical validation process across the sales organization. description:

Overview  About Nubank: Nubank was founded in 2013 with the mission of fighting complexity to empower people in their daily lives by reinventing financial services. Today, we are one of the largest digital banking platforms in the world, serving millions of customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. For more information, visit our careers page:   About The Team  The Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC) team enables Nubank to remain compliant with legal, regulatory, and internal requirements, while continuously identifying, classifying, and monitoring risks and providing strategic insights and performance evaluation to leadership. The GRC squad collaborates with multidisciplinary teams to align our technology security strategy with Nubank’s overall business objectives, ensuring that identified risks are mitigated and that risk-based decision-making is enabled within and beyond the IT & Security Business Unit.  About The Role  You will be responsible for acting as a technical reference in security, certifications, and internal controls, serving as a bridge between engineering, risk, audit, and business stakeholders. You will define strategies, support risk-based decision-making, and ensure that security and compliance requirements are effectively embedded into processes, systems, and products.  Key Responsibilities   Act as a senior technical and governance reference across security, certifications, risk, and internal controls, influencing strategy.  Identify control gaps and improvement opportunities in technical procedures required for certification and recertification processes (e.g., ISO 27001, PCI-DSS).  Develop and maintain strong partnerships with business and technical leaders to orchestrate audits, assessments, and remediation plans in a risk-based and scalable way.  Collaborate with technical teams to define action plans that ensure adherence to regulatory requirements and internal policies.  Conduct assessments of internal controls, ensuring adherence to internal policies, legal requirements, and industry standards.  Identify gaps and improvement opportunities in the internal controls landscape and lead control reviews, ensuring timely resolution of issues.  Work closely with Risk teams to align on the mitigation of identified risks.  Support responses to audit requests, regulatory inquiries, and due diligence from business partners.  Partner with Engineering, Product, IT, and global teams to integrate compliance and security requirements into processes and systems.  Define and monitor KRIs and KPIs, delivering forward-looking, data-driven insights to senior management and Committees.  Drive continuous improvement and scale, simplifying processes and strengthening Nubank’s Security Maturity as the company grows globally.    Qualification Requirements   Solid experience in information security, with strong knowledge of frameworks such as PCI-DSS, ISO 27000 family, NIST, and similar.  Prior experience with security certification processes and/or internal controls, compliance, and audit support.  Excellent executive communication skills, capable of translating complex topics into clear, actionable insights for senior leadership and committees.  Experience operating in regulated and global environments, including interaction with auditors and regulators.  Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Technology, Security Information, Risk Management or related fields.  Familiarity with using AI and automation (e.g., machine learning, generative AI, or LLM-based tooling) to enhance security compliance use cases.  Knowledge of the regulatory landscape relevant to financial services, such as SOx, BACEN, CVM, CNBV, ANBIMA, SEC, and related regulations.  Hands-on experience with cloud environments (e.g., AWS, GCP) and implementing security controls in these contexts.  Advanced English (written and verbal) required.    Nice To Have Requirements   Relevant certifications such as CRISC, CISA, Security+, CISSP, or CISM are considered a strong plus.    International experience is highly desirable.  Benefits   Chance of earning equity at Nubank  Food/ Meal Card (Vale-Refeição and/or Vale Alimentação)  Public Transportation Commuting Benefit (Vale-Transporte)  NuCare – Psychological, Financial and Legal Assistance Program  Life Insurance  Medical Plan  Dental Plan  NuLanguage – Language Course Program  Nucleo - Our learning platform of courses  Extended Parental Leave  Daycare Allowance  Parental Consultancy  Work-from-home Allowance  Gym Partnerships  30 days of paid vacation  Relocation Assistance Package, if applicable    Work Model for this Role  Hybrid 2-3 times/week: Our hybrid work model brings us to the office at least twice a week, on strategic days designed to maximize team connection and collaboration. title: Specialist Backend Software Engineer - Campinas/SP
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Specialist Backend Software Engineer - Campinas/SP em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

Sobre nós Somos orgulhosamente brasileiros e populares, digitais sempre e presenciais quando o cliente quiser. Inovamos para dar acesso a serviços financeiros e oferecemos uma experiência que encoraja as pessoas a vencerem o hoje. Nossa razão de existir é clara: lutar por uma experiência bancária que acolhe e encoraja todos os brasileiros.  E fazemos isso com disponibilidade, acolhimento e agilidade. Nossa cultura, O Jeito Agi Viver pelo cliente  - Nosso principal ativo são os clientes. A empresa só existe se conseguir resolver suas dores, entregando produtos e experiências melhores que alternativas disponíveis no mercado. Agir como empreendedor  - Quantas empresas você conhece que cobram espírito de dono do time? Muitas, né? Mas quantas delas possibilitam que as pessoas sejam de fato donas? No Agibank é assim, então aqui você age como dono porque já é dono ou porque sonha em ser o próximo. Crescer na jornada  - Nossa cultura é forte. Então, só faz sentido empreender aqui caso você se identifique muito com ela. Se você é uma pessoa fanática por resultado, tem pavor de zona de conforto, vive em eterna busca por conhecimento, prefere as coisas ditas direto ao ponto e quer estar rodeada de pessoas que também são assim, você vai curtir muito sua jornada aqui. Modelo de trabalho Híbrido  Nosso time de Tecnologia Muito mais do que código e sistemas — é o meio essencial que torna possível o nosso modelo único, que combina o melhor do digital com a presença física e humana. Aqui, tecnologia não é um fim em si mesma, mas a ponte entre inovação e a experiência real do cliente. Atuam lado a lado com as áreas de negócio para garantir soluções robustas, escaláveis e centradas nas pessoas, sem abrir mão de um olhar técnico e científico aprofundado em frentes como desenvolvimento de software, infraestrutura, cibersegurança e arquitetura. É nessa interseção entre propósito, técnica e impacto que constroem o presente e futuro. Seus desafios para crescer na jornada Liderar a equipe técnica e garantir as entregas de demandas no BFF e APP; Garantir o desenvolvimento dos micro serviços utilizando Java/Spring Boot; Ter a capacidade de gerenciar o uso de filas Kafka para comunicação entre serviços; Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares para implementar soluções eficazes; Monitorar e melhorar continuamente a performance dos serviços, utilizando ferramentas como Dynatrace, Grafana e OpenSearch.  O que você precisa para se tornar um Agilizado? Experiência comprovada em liderança técnica; Domínio em Java e Spring Boot; Experiência com desenvolvimento de micro serviços; Conhecimento em integrações BFF e Front APP; Experiência comprovada com filas Kafka; Conhecimento em bancos de dados NOSQL, como MongoDB; Familiaridade com ferramentas de observabilidade e monitoramento, como Dynatrace, Grafana e OpenSearch.  Benefícios e facilidades Saúde e bem-estar: plano de saúde, plano odontológico, teleatendimento psicológico e médico gratuito, Totalpass, Vale-refeição e alimentação e Seguro de vida/auxílio-funeral; Maternidade e paternidade: auxílio-creche, licença-maternidade de 6 meses, licença-paternidade de 20 dias, VA/VR no período da licença; Previdência privada; Programa de Participação nos Resultados (PPR) seguindo as regras estabelecidas anualmente; Vale-transporte; Fretado de ida e volta para Campinas e região (com raio de até 50 km de distância). São lugares reserváveis mediante a disponibilidade de assentos e rota. Para quem vai de carro, temos estacionamento gratuito; Folga de presente no mês do seu aniversário; Dinheiro de volta no Cartão de Crédito : 1% de cashback sobre o valor total da fatura do cartão revertido em crédito na fatura seguinte; Conta remunerada : CDB de aplicação automática e rendimento de 100% do CDI; Isenção de Tarifas de Comunicação Digital; Credito do Trabalhador : taxa e prazo diferenciados. Disponível para contratação a partir de 6 meses de casa; Antecipação Saque aniversário do FGTS; Dr. Pet: possibilidade de fazer plano de saúde para pets com até 20% de desconto.  Empresa contratante Hypeflame  Programa Tô de Dono O Tô de Dono é mais do que um programa de incentivo a longo prazo – ele é o reconhecimento de quem vive diariamente a nossa cultura. A cada ano, o Programa tem novos participantes, colaboradores que se tornam donos do negócio e ganham com a valorização do Agibank sempre que a empresa cresce. Então, quem faz parte dessa história é quem mergulha de cabeça nos desafios para entregar grandes resultados. É assim que construímos, verdadeiramente, uma cultura de donos. Aqui, a fórmula é simples: você cresce. O Agibank cresce com você. Saiba mais sobre nosso dia a dia no LinkedIn e Youtube. Confira nossas avaliações no Glassdoor.   #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Estágio em Customer Success - Relacionamento
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Estágio em Customer Success - Relacionamento em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

Na Chuva, a gente acredita que estágio deve formar, não só ocupar. Por isso, a nossa proposta é simples: trabalho real, aprendizado prático, feedback diário e autonomia conquistada. A gente fala disso desse jeito porque boa parte do mercado ainda funciona na lógica do "drenar" (brain drain): promete desenvolvimento, mas entrega só o mínimo necessário para manter você girando. Nós construímos o oposto disso: Brain Bridges  (Pontes de Conhecimento). Você traz energia, iniciativa, curiosidade e vontade de aprender. Nós entramos com 18 anos de experiência em uma empresa de tecnologia independente, contato direto com os fundadores, acompanhamento e um ambiente seguro para você testar, errar, ajustar e evoluir. Nosso trabalho impulsiona a ciência apoiando mais de 800 mil pesquisadores no mundo  com o Galoá, plataforma que viabiliza o Proceedings Science, o maior acervo de acesso aberto de eventos científicos do Brasil. Se você busca um estágio convencional, o mercado oferece muitas opções. Mas, se você quer uma experiência intensa de aprendizado prático, com tecnologia, responsabilidade e impacto real, seu lugar pode ser aqui.  O que é o Programa Gerente de Si?  Trabalhar com propósito exige mais autoconhecimento, autonomia e maturidade profissional. A nossa resposta é: como se aprende isso na prática? Na Chuva, transformamos esse desafio em formação concreta. Chamamos isso de Gerente de Si, um jeito de garantir a evolução contínua:   Organização: planejar a própria semana  Priorização: entender o que precisa ser feito primeiro  Levantar a mão: pedir ajuda cedo, sem esconder dificuldades  Accountability: mostrar o andamento do trabalho sem ninguém precisar cobrar  Maturidade: ouvir e dar feedback sem levar para o lado pessoal  Autonomia: usar tecnologia para trabalhar melhor, não só mais rápido    É isso que você vai aprender e praticar aqui ao longo do estágio. Nem tudo será glamouroso. Haverá tarefas operacionais e repetitivas, porque consistência  também forma repertório. Ao mesmo tempo, você terá contato com IA, melhoria de processos e problemas reais de uma empresa em movimento.  Na trilha de Customer Success (Relacionamento) você vai atuar principalmente em quatro frentes:   Comunicação com clientes: Triagem, leitura e envio de e-mails, apoiando pesquisadores de diferentes países com uma comunicação clara, respeitosa e educativa  Uso de IA e configuração de soluções: Apoio em setups, identificação de padrões, resolução de dúvidas recorrentes e treinamento de bots  Precisão de dados e processos: Higienização e importação de dados com alto nível de cuidado, reduzindo erros e retrabalho  Projetos de melhoria: Resolução de pequenos desafios reais com nossa supervisão, buscando deixar processos mais simples, rápidos e confiáveis    O que pode te frustrar aqui   As coisas mudam rápido: Não somos uma empresa engessada. Quando aparece um caminho melhor, ajustamos a rota  A curva de aprendizado é alta: Você não precisa chegar sabendo tudo. Mas precisa querer aprender, se dedicar e evoluir com consistência  Comunicação diária: Você vai ler, escrever, ouvir feedback e precisar pedir ajuda quando travar, em vez de sumir com o problema    Requisitos  Sua parte na ponte (O que você traz para o estágio):   Matrícula ativa e atestada: a partir do 3º ano de qualquer curso de graduação (Exatas, Humanas ou Biológicas)  Disponibilidade e curiosidade: 6 horas por dia (30h semanais)  Afinidade com tecnologia: não irá programar, só não pode ter medo de fuçar em softwares novos e plataformas web  A matéria-prima do Gerente de Si (Autorresponsabilidade): não é saber gestão de tempo e ter inteligência emocional, isso faz parte do que vamos ensinar. Mas precisa trazer humildade para ouvir, coragem para sinalizar quando travar e disposição para assumir responsabilidade pelo próprio desenvolvimento    Benefits   Bolsa + Benefícios: R$ 1.950,00 (R$ 1.200 + R$ 750)  Auxílio transporte: flexível conforme a sua necessidade de deslocamento  Híbrido: pelo menos 3x por semana no nosso QG em Barão Geraldo, perto da Unicamp  Kumbatia e CumbuChuva: investimos o nosso tempo na sua formação adicionando clube do livro e treinamentos internos  Flexibilidade real: Sabemos como é a semana de provas e imprevistos. Ajustamos os horários baseados no seu cronograma escolar    Etapa essencial da candidatura  Antes de concluir sua candidatura, leia nossos materiais de cultura em nosso site. No campo de inscrição, envie 3 perguntas que surgiram da sua leitura. Pelo menos 1 delas deve se conectar à ideia de "sobre ombros de gigantes" e ao tipo de legado que você quer ajudar a construir. Não estamos procurando a pergunta perfeita. Queremos entender se você realmente leu, pensou e ficou curioso(o).   #J-18808-Ljbffr

Learn more on how BEES keeps business buzzing at   About the Role  The Commercial Strategy Specialist is responsible for maximizing profitable growth across BEES Link 3P through strong governance, analytical rigor, and scalable operating standards. Aligned with our mission — to maximize profitable growth by institutionalizing pricing compliance, P&L governance, disciplined product prioritization, and scalable operating processes — this role plays a critical part in strengthening the structural foundations of our commercial model.  This position sits at the intersection of Commercial, Product, Finance, and Operations. The Commercial Strategy Specialist transforms complex business problems into data‑driven insights and scalable frameworks that protect margins, improve investment allocation, and accelerate disciplined decision‑making. title: Senior IT Engineer – Global Offices Network
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Senior IT Engineer – Global Offices Network em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

Nu is one of the largest digital financial platforms in the world, with more than 127 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. Guided by our mission to fight complexity and empower people, we are redefining financial services in Latin America — and this is still just the beginning of the purple future we’re building. Listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: NU), we combine proprietary technology, data intelligence, and an efficient operating model to deliver financial products that are simple, accessible, and human. Our impact has been recognized by global rankings such as Time 100 Companies, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and Forbes World’s Best Bank. Learn more about our career opportunities here.  About The Role  We are looking for a Senior IT Engineer  to design, implement, and operate our global office and data center network . In this role, you will own the connectivity and performance of Nu’s physical locations, ensuring that our offices and data centers are reliable, secure, and ready to support our next waves of growth. You will work on routing, switching, wireless, security, and observability  across our global stack, leading key initiatives such as new office rollouts, critical connectivity improvements, and the evolution towards Infrastructure as Code (IaC) . You will be part of the Global Offices Network  team, working closely with peers in Connectivity, Security, and Workplace to provide a seamless experience for Nubankers worldwide. What You’ll Be Responsible For  Network & Connectivity   Design, implement, and support enterprise network infrastructure for offices and data centers, including routing, switching, and wireless.  Maintain and evolve high-availability data center fabrics (e.g., spine-and-leaf topologies with Juniper/Cisco hardware).  Ensure robust connectivity between offices and data centers, including WAN and SD-WAN solutions, focusing on performance, reliability, and scalability.    Wireless, Load Balancing & Security   Configure and support wireless networks (controllers and access points), with strong experience in vendors such as Aruba and Cisco.  Operate and tune load balancers (e.g., F5, including DNS/ZoneRunner concepts) to guarantee optimal application delivery and resilience.  Collaborate with security teams on Next-Generation Firewalls (e.g., Palo Alto, Fortinet) and cloud security brokers (e.g., Zscaler) in a “security-first” network design.    Automation, IaC & Observability   Drive the transition away from manual configuration towards Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using tools such as GitHub, Terraform, and/or Ansible.  Implement and maintain network performance monitoring and observability using tools like PRTG, Prometheus, Grafana, SolarWinds or similar, ensuring proactive detection and resolution of incidents.  Manage PKI-related activities, including SSL/TLS certificate lifecycle and ensuring secure encrypted communications across services and endpoints.    Delivery & Collaboration   Lead or co-lead new office implementations and major network changes, coordinating with Workplace, Connectivity, and other partner teams.  Act as a technical reference for incident response and problem management in critical networking issues, helping restore services quickly and preventing recurrences.  Document architectures, runbooks, and standards, helping scale knowledge across the team.  Mentor more junior engineers and collaborate in a multi-level team (IC6, IC5, IC3, IC4) to continuously improve how we operate our global infrastructure.    We Are Looking for a Person Who Has   5+ years of experience in enterprise networking or infrastructure engineering, working with critical environments (e.g., large offices, data centers, or mission-critical operations).  Strong hands-on experience with routing and switching, ideally using vendors such as Cisco and/or Juniper.  Experience implementing and supporting wireless networks, especially with Aruba and/or Cisco wireless solutions.  Solid experience operating network monitoring and performance tools (e.g., PRTG, SolarWinds, Prometheus, Grafana or similar) in production environments.  Experience with load balancers (e.g., F5) and DNS-related components (e.g., ZoneRunner or equivalent).  Exposure to network security components, such as enterprise firewalls and/or security brokers, and comfort collaborating with security teams in a “security-first” posture.  Experience with or strong interest in Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and automation for network configuration and lifecycle management (e.g., GitHub, Terraform, Ansible).  Ability to lead initiatives and coordinate teams during new office rollouts, complex changes, and incident response.  Strong problem-solving skills, ownership mindset, and ability to work in cross-functional, multicultural teams.  Intermediate English (spoken and written), with the ability to participate in meetings and collaborate with global teams.    Nice to Have   Familiarity with Zero Trust network concepts and security-driven networking.  Experience with cloud networking (e.g., connectivity to public clouds) and hybrid environments.  Experience with security mindset and encryption topics (e.g., secure protocols, network segmentation), even if not your primary specialization.  Prior experience in distributed or global organizations.    Location  This opportunity is based in Brazil , with a strong preference for candidates who can work from our offices in:   Rio de Janeiro, Brazil  Belo Horizonte, Brazil    You will be part of the Brazil Global Offices Network team and collaborate with colleagues in other locations as needed.  Our Benefits – Brazil  For Employees Based In Brazil, We Offer   Chance of earning equity at Nubank  Food/Meal Card (Vale-Refeição and/or Vale-Alimentação)  Public Transportation Commuting Benefit (Vale-Transporte)  NuCare – Psychological, Financial and Legal Assistance Program  Life Insurance  Medical Plan  Dental Plan  NuLanguage – Language Course Program  Nucleo – Our learning platform of courses  Extended Parental Leave  Daycare Allowance  Parental Consultancy  Work-from-home Allowance  Gym Partnerships  30 days of paid vacation  Relocation Assistance Package, if applicable    Work Model for This Role  This role follows our hybrid work model . Our hybrid work model brings us to the office at least 2–3 times per week , on strategic days designed to maximize team connection and collaboration. For more details, visit our article about Nu’s hybrid work model.  Learn More About How We Build Technology At Nu   building.nubank.com.br  youtube.com/@building.nubank  Listen to our stories on Spotify     #J-18808-Ljbffr

We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI‑powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well‑being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.  The Role  As a System Administrator at Kyndryl, you’ll solve complex problems and identify potential future issues across the spectrum of platforms and services. You’ll be at the forefront of new technology and modernization, working with some of our biggest clients – which means some of the biggest in the world.  There’s never a typical day as a System Administrator at Kyndryl, because no two projects are alike. You’ll be managing systems data for clients and providing day‑to‑day solutions and security compliance. You’ll oversee a queue of assignments and work directly with technicians, prioritizing tickets to deliver the best solutions to our clients.  One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here. You’ll also get the chance to share your expertise by recommending modernization options, identifying new business opportunities, and cultivating relationships with other teams and stakeholders. Does the work get challenging at times? Yes! But you’ll collaborate with a diverse group of talented people and gain invaluable management and organizational skills, which will come in handy as you move forward in your career.  Your future at Kyndryl  Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career, from Junior System Administrator to Architect. We have opportunities for Cloud Hyperscalers that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands‑on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.  Who You Are  Você é bom no que faz e possui a experiência necessária para comprovar isso. No entanto, tão importante quanto isso é o seu mindset de crescimento : alguém motivado a impulsionar o próprio desenvolvimento pessoal e profissional. Você é focado no cliente  — alguém que prioriza o sucesso do cliente em seu trabalho. E, por fim, você é aberto e sem fronteiras  — naturalmente inclusivo na forma como trabalha com os outros. Se quiser, posso adaptar o tom (mais formal, mais corporativo, ou mais próximo de uma descrição de vaga/perfil profissional). Realizar parametrizações , melhorias , sustentacao e configurações .  Analisar gaps funcionais e propor soluções sustentáveis em conformidade com as best practices SAP.  Garantir que as melhorias entregues estejam alinhadas ao conceito de Clean Core (especialmente em ambientes S/4HANA).    Diferenciais   Inglês avançado  Definições de Arquitetura  Suporte na definição de processos  Tuning de ambientes  Conhecimento em suporte a ambientes em Cloud (MultiCloud)    Being You  The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.  What You Can Expect  Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid‑friendly culture that supports your well‑being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health — because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.  From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.  We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in‑demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting‑edge learning opportunities — from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands‑on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.  We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.  Get Referred! Empresa  RGE – Uma empresa do Grupo CPFL Energia.  Principais Atividades  Atender às solicitações relacionadas ao Grupo A demandadas pelas áreas internas e externas, visando o rápido e eficiente atendimento; controlar, manipular e arquivar documentos físicos; contribuir para o cumprimento dos prazos e pela qualidade de entrega de cada processo; dar suporte administrativo às tarefas relativas à gestão dos processos da distribuição, recursos humanos e efetuar no SAP pagamentos de fornecedores de serviços e materiais, visando o cumprimento de prazos, normas e regulamentações. Apoio ao atendimento das demandas do site de projetos, e-mail e telefone.  Apoiar na emissão de orçamentos de obras, faturas e TCD referente aos pedidos de parcelamentos, de acordo com as normas e procedimentos da empresa e regulação do setor. Extrair relatórios de inadimplências e controle de metas dos analistas.  Encaminhar aos clientes documentos tais como contratos, cartas, entre outros, conforme demandado pelas áreas internas.  Executar atividades relacionadas aos processos de geração distribuída e migração ao mercado livre.  Necessário ensino médio completo. Acreditamos que equipes plurais e um ambiente inclusivo para todas as pessoas são fundamentais para a sustentabilidade de organizações inovadoras e com foco em clientes, por isso, valorizamos a pluralidade e orientamos nossas ações para garantir uma cultura inclusiva e oportunidades a todas as pessoas.   #J-18808-Ljbffr

By stripping away the friction of traditional e-commerce checkouts, we are building an ecosystem where secure, instant payments are accessible across all channels—from online carts to physical stores via digital wallets. You will join the NuPay team as a technical anchor, driving the evolution of a payments stack that balances massive scale with ironclad reliability. This role is about more than just moving bits; it’s about architecting the financial infrastructure that millions of people and businesses rely on to grow, ensuring every transaction is a bridge of trust between Nubank and our partners. As a senior technical leader, you will oversee the technical direction of our payment features, navigating the complexities of authorization and settlement while mentoring the next generation of engineers. Lead technical design  for core payment lifecycles—including authorization, capture, settlement, and reconciliation—while balancing performance with security. Background in high-criticality FinTech , specifically within Payments or Core Banking environments governed by strict SLAs. Evidence of delivering high-throughput systems  using modern engineering practices, including automated testing, observability, and safe rollout strategies. Experience mentoring senior engineers , fostering a culture of technical excellence and shared ownership across organizational boundaries.  Nice to Have Experience with acquiring, sub-acquiring, or payment gateway architecture. Previous involvement with e-commerce or marketplace platforms managing proprietary payment stacks. description:

About Us   Nu is one of the largest digital financial platforms in the world, with more than 122 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. Guided by our mission to fight complexity and empower people, we are redefining financial services in Latin America and this is still just the beginning of the purple future we're building.  Listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: NU), we combine proprietary technology, data intelligence, and an efficient operating model to deliver financial products that are simple, accessible, and human.  Our impact has been recognized by global rankings such as Time 100 Companies, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and Forbes World’s Best Bank. Visit our institutional page   Business Analysts at Nubank   As a company at the forefront of the financial revolution in Brazil, Nubank has experienced exponential growth since its inception. To keep your growth path healthy, numerous critical decisions constantly need to be made. Business Analysts are fundamental in the decision process because they must not only be able to deal with large amounts of information and data, but also always think of ways to improve our clients' experience.  It is BA's responsibility to structure the data, analyze it and use the results to test different solutions with the aim of improving Nubank's efficiency.  We are looking for people who are independent and who are not afraid to take the initiative to identify and solve problems that are not necessarily obvious.  You can read more about it in our blog and get some insights into how we work.  As a Business Analyst, you’re expected to:    Do a lot of investigative work, focused on deciding which data makes the most sense to use in which situation. If you don't have the data, it's your job to think about what tests can be done or how to extract the information you need to answer your questions;  Support your team in making data-based decisions by monitoring analysis and decisions, ensuring the flow of projects and making the process of taking risks comfortable despite the uncertainties;  Learning how to work with a large volume of data to build a solid foundation for decision making with calculated risks - even knowing that not all the answers are in the data and/or that not all the data you would like is available;Use tools like SQL, Python and Scala - taught during your first weeks with us - for data extraction;  Understand our products and interactions with other areas;  Take advantage of opportunities to grow and learn from a well-prepared and highly qualified team;  Opportunity to work in a complex, dynamic and diverse environment, participating in projects that will impact a large number of clients.    What are we looking for?    People with disabilities (PcD - pessoa com deficiencia)  Analytical capacity: ease with numbers and calculations, having the ability to solve problems mathematically;  Business basics: dynamics between risks and opportunities, as well as interaction between business areas and technical areas (products/engineering);  Problem solving: ease and creativity to seek solutions to day-to-day challenges and achieve the best results;  Ability to understand how your decisions and work impact our customers' experience, seeking results that align with our purpose;  Willingness and ease of learning, especially for tools;  Openness to receive feedback and incorporate it into your daily life and development;  Adaptability to the multifunctional environment;  Good english speaking skills to be a part of a global team;  Profiles that add value to Nubank's culture. Embora o carro tenha um papel fundamental na vida de muitas pessoas, só 25% da população da América Latina consegue ter acesso a ele. E foi por isso que a Kovi nasceu: para mudar essa estatística!  Acreditamos que todas as pessoas merecem ter a oportunidade de dirigir suas próprias vidas e, em busca desse propósito, trabalhamos todos os dias para criar soluções de mobilidade acessíveis, flexíveis e simples.  Hoje, já oferecemos planos de aluguel no inédito modelo "pague o que usar", compra de carros sem análise de crédito e seguro auto com contratação simplificada. E queremos continuar promovendo a inclusão, através da eficiência e inovação!  O desafio é grande, mas nossa vontade de fazer a diferença é ainda maior! E estamos buscando pessoas incríveis para fazer parte dessa revolução.  Se você acreditar em um mundo onde todos tenham oportunidade de dirigir suas próprias vidas, vem ser #Kover!  Ser Kover é sinônimo de ser super engajado quando o assunto é desafio. Amamos pessoas que se importam com outras pessoas, que tenham brilho nos olhos e vontade de sobra para mudar o mundo. Se você acredita em um mundo onde todos tenham oportunidade de dirigir suas próprias vidas, vem ser #Kover! ♥  Responsabilidades e atribuições   Realizar regulação nas oficinas externas que possuem carros da Kovi em reparação;  Verificar se o prazo de entrega está condizente e acompanhar se a reparação está dentro do cronograma;  Avaliar se o preço das peças estão dentro dos padrões de mercado e se realmente são necessárias para troca ou se podem ser reparadas;  Avaliar a qualidade dos serviços realizados, através de acompanhamento diário dos veículos;  Apontar eventuais problemas, como falta de peças e/ou gestões incorretas das oficinas;  Apresentar os resultados das oficinas sob sua responsabilidade com planos de ações para cada carro/situação. Dinâmico, para conseguir entender rapidamente os fatos e procurar saídas de forma ágil;  Conhecimento em ferramentas do Google (Gmail, Sheets) e Cilia;  Boa comunicação escrita e verbal;  Formação técnica em manutenção de veículos;  Morar em Campinas.    Informações adicionais   O Que Você Vai Encontrar Aqui   Seguro de Vida : Para cuidarmos do nosso bem maior: nossos Kovers.  Plano de Saúde : É importante se cuidar e estar bem.  Plano Odontológico : Para você dar aquele sorrisão bonito!  Cartão Flash : Seu VR e/ou VA em um único cartão! Até porque como diz o ditado: "saco vazio não para em pé!".  Vale-Transporte ou Vale-Combustível : A escolha de como você se move é só sua.  Pai, mãe e filhos : Auxílio creche, licença maternidade estendida de 180 dias e licença paternidade estendida de 20 dias.  Wellhub : Todos os Kovers têm direito a se exercitar com parte do valor subsidiado pela Kovi.  Kovenção : A reunião que a liderança da Kovi tem com a empresa inteira para que todos fiquem por dentro do status do negócio.    Sobre a Kovi  Na Kovi, acreditamos que mobilidade muda direções. Nascemos em 2018 com um propósito claro: criar oportunidades para que todos possam dirigir suas vidas. Hoje, somos referência em oferecer soluções inovadoras para clientes, promovendo inclusão financeira e autonomia para quem movimenta as cidades.  Mais do que uma empresa de tecnologia, somos um time apaixonado por impacto real. Aqui, combinamos dados, empatia e ousadia para criar um ecossistema justo, sustentável e acessível. E isso é só o começo.  Nossa cultura  Nossa cultura é viva, diversa e colaborativa. Valorizamos pessoas curiosas, que aprendem rápido, pensam diferente e constroem junto. Na Kovi, você tem liberdade para ser quem é, e espaço para crescer como nunca imaginou.  Acreditamos no poder da inovação como motor da mudança. Por isso, incentivamos ideias novas, experimentações e decisões com base em dados. Também somos movidos por um forte senso de dono: cada pessoa aqui é protagonista da sua jornada.  Diversidade importa. Inclusão também. Por isso, estamos comprometidos em construir um ambiente seguro, respeitoso e acolhedor para todas as pessoas.  Se você busca propósito, desafios reais e quer fazer parte de um time que está reinventando o presente para construir um futuro mais justo, seu lugar pode ser aqui.   #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Lead IT Engineer - Service Management
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Lead IT Engineer - Service Management em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Us  Nu is one of the largest digital financial platforms in the world, with more than 127 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. Guided by our mission to fight complexity and empower people, we are redefining financial services in Latin America — and this is still just the beginning of the purple future we're building. Listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: NU), we combine proprietary technology, data intelligence, and an efficient operating model to deliver financial products that are simple, accessible, and human. Our impact has been recognized by global rankings such as Time 100 Companies, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and Forbes World’s Best Bank. Learn more at   About the Team  The IT team is the operational backbone of Nubank’s internal infrastructure. As the company scales, we’re building the service management foundations that let engineering teams move faster with more confidence — turning IT operations into a strategic advantage, not just a support function.  About the Role  As a Lead IT Engineer - Service Management, you will own and evolve Nubank’s IT Service Management (ITSM) practice end to end. You’ll design and implement processes, tools, and governance that keep our internal services reliable, auditable, and efficient, enabling engineering teams to focus on high‑impact work while maintaining strong operational controls in a regulated environment.  You’ll Be Responsible For   Continuing to build and own Nubank's ITSM practice, defining and implementing core ITIL v4 processes: incident, problem, change, service request, and knowledge management.  Establishing a service catalog with clearly defined SLAs and OLAs aligned with internal stakeholder expectations.  Owning the end‑to‑end ITSM toolchain (Jira Service Management or equivalent): configuration, workflow design, form logic, SLA rules, and integrations with adjacent systems.  Identifying and closing automation gaps — routing, escalation, notifications, and reporting — partnering with engineering teams to reduce manual toil across operations.  Defining and tracking operational KPIs (MTTR, SLA compliance, first‑contact resolution, change success rate) and building regular reporting cadences for leadership and stakeholders.  Establishing a Change Advisory Board (CAB) with structured documentation and approval workflows.  Supporting audit and compliance requirements with structured evidence of IT operational controls, essential for a regulated financial environment.  Driving ITSM adoption across the organization, creating runbooks, training materials, and documentation that embed service management culture at scale.    Mandatory qualifications   7+ years of experience in IT service management, IT operations, or a related discipline.  Deep ITIL v4 expertise; ITIL 4 Foundation or Managing Professional certification strongly preferred.  Proven track record of building ITSM practices from scratch or significantly transforming an existing function.  Hands‑on experience owning and configuring ITSM tooling end‑to‑end (Jira Service Management, ServiceNow, or equivalent) — not just using it, but designing it.  Ability to work cross‑functionally in a fast‑paced, engineering‑led environment, with strong influence‑without‑authority skills.  Strong written and verbal communication, including the ability to present to senior leadership.    Nice‑to‑have qualifications   Experience in fintech, high‑growth tech, or other regulated industries.  Familiarity with adjacent frameworks: COBIT, ISO 20000, or SRE principles.  Experience partnering with Security and/or Platform Engineering teams.    What We Offer   Greenfield, high‑visibility scope: you’ll define what “good” ITSM looks like at Nubank’s scale — from zero.  Direct exposure to senior leadership across IT and Engineering.  A culture that values ownership and getting foundations right, without bureaucracy for its own sake.  Chance of earning equity at Nubank.  Public Transportation Commuting Benefit (Vale‑Transporte).  NuCare – Psychological, Financial and Legal Assistance Program.  Life Insurance.  Medical Plan.  NuLanguage – Language Course Program.  Nucleo – Our learning platform of courses.  Extended Parental Leave.  Daycare Allowance.  Parental Consultancy.  Work‑from‑home Allowance.  30 days of paid vacation.  Relocation Assistance Package, if applicable.    (For hybrid roles, commuting‑related benefits such as Vale‑Transporte and gym partnerships remain applicable.)  Work Model for This Role  Hybrid – 2–3 times per week in the office.   Our hybrid work model brings us to the office at least twice a week, on strategic days designed to maximize team connection and collaboration. For more details, visit   Exploring Nubank  Explore how we build technology at Nubank:  At Nubank, we want to be sure that we’re building a more diverse and inclusive workplace that reflects the customers we serve and seek to empower. That’s why we hire based on equality. We consider gender, ethnicity, race, religion, sexual orientation, and other identity markers as enriching elements to our company, while ensuring none of them represent a barrier when recruiting fantastic talent.  How to Apply  If you’re excited about building a robust IT Service Management foundation that enables Nubank to scale with reliability and speed, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now and help us shape the future of financial services in Latin America.   #J-18808-Ljbffr
